entities.summary: Thomas Leuthard (b. 1971-10-05, Zug) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Zug and Switzerland. Known in the fields of switzerland, painters & sculptors, europe.
